scope: Installed-service injected interruption of native exit observation during managed return, followed by explicit recovery

injection.method: Test-only root transient unit paused (SIGSTOP) only the newly committed native production guardian, verified by unit MainPID and process start ticks, then continued (SIGCONT) the same process after 25 s
injection.effect: The worker exited on shutdown but stayed a zombie under the paused guardian, so the service's real 10 s exit-observation deadline expired

qn90a.failure_cause: Production exit evidence unavailable: exit deadline expired

s90d.failure_cause: Production exit evidence unavailable: exit deadline expired

limitations: Only the exit-observation deadline boundary was injected on hardware; stopped-receipt publication failure, provider loss and transport closure are covered by local tests only.
Recovery requires the live coordinator and the bounded provider (300 s lifetime); service-restart reconciliation is not implemented.
Public admission remained held while native was selected; this is not public API parity.
No reboot or standby/resume qualification was performed.
Managed acquisition and fallback dependencies remain deployed and selected.
